quote: An authorized emergency vehicle may be equipped with a siren, whistle or bell, capable of emitting sound audible under normal conditions from a distance of not less than 500 feet, but the siren must not be used except when the vehicle is operated in response to an emergency call or in the immediate pursuit of an actual or suspected violator of the law, in which event the driver of the vehicle may sound the siren to warn pedestrians and other drivers of his or her approach. A driver of an emergency vehicle may operate the vehicle’s warning lamps without sounding the siren.

activation.description: Authorization and actor identity require independent original source records.

obligation.source_clause: the siren must not be used except when the vehicle is operated in response to an emergency call or in the immediate pursuit of an actual or suspected violator of the law
obligation.description: Observe siren output and response or pursuit source on the same original frame window.

exceptions.source_clause: when the vehicle is operated in response to an emergency call
exceptions.description: Documented emergency-call operation is a qualifying siren-use branch.

exceptions.source_clause: in the immediate pursuit of an actual or suspected violator of the law
exceptions.description: Documented immediate pursuit is the alternative qualifying branch.

exceptions.source_clause: may operate the vehicle’s warning lamps without sounding the siren
exceptions.description: Measure lamp and siren independently in a lamps-only branch.

timing.source_clause: when the vehicle is operated in response to an emergency call or in the immediate pursuit
timing.description: Compare source-grounded response intervals with the audible siren interval.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Equipment audibility at 500 feet requires a qualified original acoustic assessment.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: actual or suspected violator of the law
judgment_calls_needed.note: Pursuit purpose and the factual status of a suspected violator require original dispatch and incident sources.
